notes.text: Several expositions are consecutive; the witness alternates ben and bar.
The locus calls him Pinḥas the priest, bar Ḥama.
Shoḥer Tov names him explicitly with the priestly title.
Both parallels place the tithe with Pinḥas. The Yerushalmi has the recipient decline, while the Qohelet Rabbah physician withholds transmission after asking.
Bereshit Rabbah attests Pinḥas in Aivu’s name without a patronymic at this point.
Buber gives Pinḥas in the name of Ḥilkiyah the Southerner with the additional link to Reuven.
